title: Katy Perry Visits Christ the Redeemer, Reflects on Divine Timing Before Rio Concert
htmlContent:
Katy Perry shared a touching moment on Instagram just before her upcoming concert in Rio de Janeiro, where she performed for over 100,000 fans. Late in the evening, the pop star went to the Sanctuary of Christ the Redeemer to express gratitude and receive blessings for her performance. Perry expressed her belief in synchronicity, calling it 'the language of the Divine,' and connected the timing of her visit to the release of her song '143.'
Perry wrote about the significance of the number 143, "When I heard that tonight’s show sold out in May in 1 hour and 43 minutes, I knew this was exactly where I was supposed to be for the release of 143. Divine timing, aligned.
Since releasing the record, the singer shared her profound emotions, saying her heart is full of love because of the joy and light the music has brought her fans. The album aimed to share her newfound confidence reignited light, and connection to the feminine Divine within her, which she attributes to her motherhood journey.
"Thank you for listening to 143," Perry continued. "You have been waiting so long for this metamorphosis, and I am ready to take flight now."
Perry urged fans who couldn't attend the festival to watch the live stream on her website, ensuring everyone could participate in the special night. As Perry prepared for her performance, her visit to Christ the Redeemer marked a decisive moment of gratitude and reflection. She reminded fans of her connection to her art, faith, and audience.
